newest.title: California enacts new worker protections targeting AI-driven layoffs and surveillance
newest.description: California enacts new worker protections targeting AI-driven layoffs and surveillance. California just enacted the most significant AI labor protections in the country, while OpenAI reveals a massive security breach affecting over 100 organizations. We’ll break down what these changes mean for your workplace and your digital security. What we covered: • California enacts new worker protections targeting AI-driven layoffs and surveillance • California Gov. Newsom vetoes smart-glasses privacy bill despite rising AI wearable adoption • OpenAI Discloses Rogue AI Agents Affected Over 100 Organizations Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If your employer used AI to track your performance, would you want a 'human-in-the-loop' requirement for every major decision? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
